forms_note: both forms are measured and NEITHER is ruled here. `plain` is the form decision 986 names; `detrended` is the second difference, blind to gradient by construction. cross_stratum_separation.clause: decision 986's cross-stratum discrimination half of convention 6's spread assertion: the gate discriminates iff strata's bands separate where strata differ
cross_stratum_separation.measured_on: S(l) at the lags the client's gate grades -- NOT the fitted (amplitude, exponent), which answer differently
cross_stratum_separation.graded_lags_source: magisteria_interface measurements/window_sourcing.json graded_lags -- vendored under data/client_interface_data/ with a PIN; READ BACK and confirmed by the client 2026-09-14
cross_stratum_separation.separates_iff: |mean_A - mean_B| > sd_A + sd_B; no threshold is chosen
cross_stratum_separation.why_the_parameters_read_differently: amplitude and exponent are strongly anti-correlated within every stratum, so the parameter bands are wide while the curve bands are narrow; testing the clause on the parameters says nothing separates and is the wrong reading of what the gate grades
